note: Two parallel procurement chains. They are never merged, morphed or shown as one lineage. Chain A is not the origin of Chain B.

A.label: Chain A
A.one_line: The council-linked November 2023 purchase: 130 in-car systems, cloud video evidence software, and an agency-data plate-reader licence.
A.vendor_note: Illinois corporation. Contract counterparty was WatchGuard Video, Inc. until Amendment #2 renamed it after integration on 14 February 2022.
A.city_signature_authority: Mayor Pro Tem Connie Boesen, per council resolution
addenda: Equipment Purchase and Software License Addendum (20 Nov 2023)
A.data_scope: Agency data only. The purchased plate-reader SKU is defined by the vendor's own price file as CarDetector Mobile with Vigilant PlateSearch, agency data only.

B.label: Chain B
B.one_line: An earlier, separately executed administrative procurement: the hosted plate-reader platform, three years of commercial national vehicle-location data, and fixed roadside cameras.
B.vendor_note: Delaware LLC, a Motorola company. One Vigilant instrument uses “Motorola” as its defined term for the Vigilant entity — a live trap for anyone quoting these documents.
B.city_signature_authority: Administrative. Finance Director Nickolas Schaul signed W23-383; Deputy City Manager Matt Anderson signed the 29 September 2023 amendment.
B.council_action_label: No council action for any Chain B instrument appears in the records reviewed. Not found is not the same as nonexistence.
addenda: Equipment Purchase Amendment + Vigilant-party EPSLA (29 Sept 2023)
B.data_scope: Commercial national vehicle-location data (VS-IDP-03) plus the hosted LEARN / VehicleManager account and fixed roadside cameras.

upstream.label: Upstream
upstream.one_line: How plate readers entered the Sourcewell price list that Des Moines later bought from.
upstream.vendor_of_record: WatchGuard Video, Inc., later Motorola Solutions, Inc.

platform.label: The 2026 snapshot
platform.one_line: Three exports generated by the City from its VehicleManager account on 17 August 2026. A snapshot, not a history.

meeting_point.label: One platform, two contracts
meeting_point.copy: Both chains arrive at the same platform. They arrive as two separate rails at one block — never as a merge. The record shows two contracts and one platform, and the exhibit draws it that way.
